_doc: Second Kimodo batch: the locomotion core in one consistent zombie style, so a pure-Kimodo
clip set exists (idle + hold idles + shamble/walk ladder + backward/side walks + 45 deg arcs +
standing pivots). Same frame conventions as clips.json. direction_deg moves relative to the
heading (180 = walking backward, +90 = strafing left) while the heading is held.

clips.name: k_idle
clips.note: the waiting idle: long, in place (retarget with :idle), calm sway
prompts: A zombie stands still swaying slightly with its head tilted and arms hanging loosely
An injured person stands still swaying slightly like a zombie with arms hanging loosely

clips.name: k_hold_1
clips.note: aggressive standing idle for the hold phase (in place)
prompts: A zombie stands in place snarling and reaching out with both arms toward someone in front of it
An angry injured person stands in place like a zombie reaching out with both arms toward someone in front

clips.name: k_hold_2
clips.note: second hold idle: shifting weight, clawing (in place)
prompts: A zombie stands in place shifting its weight from foot to foot and clawing at the air
An injured person stands in place like a zombie shifting weight from foot to foot and clawing at the air

clips.name: k_shamble
prompts: A zombie shambles forward very slowly dragging one leg with arms hanging loosely
An injured person shambles forward very slowly dragging one leg like a zombie

clips.name: k_walk
prompts: A zombie walks forward with a stiff lurching gait and arms hanging loosely
An injured person walks forward with a stiff lurching gait like a zombie

clips.name: k_walk_fast
prompts: A zombie walks forward quickly with a stiff lurching gait and arms reaching forward
An injured person walks forward quickly with a stiff lurching gait like a zombie with arms reaching forward

clips.name: k_run
clips.note: jog 1.8 m/s, bridging to k_run_fast at 2.5
prompts: A zombie jogs forward with a lurching stride and arms reaching out
An injured person jogs forward with a lurching stride like a zombie with arms reaching out

clips.name: k_walk_back
clips.note: walking backward 0.6 m/s while facing forward
prompts: A zombie walks backward slowly with stiff legs keeping its head facing forward
An injured person walks backward slowly like a zombie keeping its head facing forward

clips.name: k_side_walk_l
prompts: A zombie sidesteps to its left with stiff legs while facing forward
An injured person sidesteps to the left like a zombie while facing forward

clips.name: k_side_walk_r
prompts: A zombie sidesteps to its right with stiff legs while facing forward
An injured person sidesteps to the right like a zombie while facing forward

clips.name: k_walk_turn_l_45
prompts: A zombie walks forward with a stiff lurching gait and curves gently to the left
An injured person walks forward like a zombie and curves gently to the left

clips.name: k_walk_turn_r_45
prompts: A zombie walks forward with a stiff lurching gait and curves gently to the right
An injured person walks forward like a zombie and curves gently to the right

clips.name: k_run_turn_l_45
prompts: A zombie runs forward with a lurching stride and curves to the left
An injured person runs forward like a zombie and curves to the left

clips.name: k_run_turn_r_45
prompts: A zombie runs forward with a lurching stride and curves to the right
An injured person runs forward like a zombie and curves to the right

clips.name: k_stand_turn_l_90
clips.note: standing pivot: stop, turn in place, stop
prompts: A zombie standing still turns in place to its left and stands still again
An injured person standing still turns in place to the left like a zombie and stands still again

clips.name: k_stand_turn_r_90
prompts: A zombie standing still turns in place to its right and stands still again
An injured person standing still turns in place to the right like a zombie and stands still again

clips.name: k_stand_turn_l_180
prompts: A zombie standing still turns around in place to its left and stands still again
An injured person standing still turns around in place to the left like a zombie and stands still again

clips.name: k_stand_turn_r_180
prompts: A zombie standing still turns around in place to its right and stands still again
An injured person standing still turns around in place to the right like a zombie and stands still again
